outputs.AS_overall: coverage-aware geometric mean sqrt(AS_progress_effective * AS_yaw_effective); official 0-1 ranking score
outputs.AS_progress_effective: acceptable longitudinal intervals divided by four expected intervals per declared row; abstentions receive no credit
outputs.AS_yaw_effective: correct visual/action turn directions divided by all applicable non-straight action rows; missing visual yaw receives no credit
outputs.AS_yaw: turn-direction agreement on applicable non-straight rows
outputs.AS_progress: fraction of future intervals accepted by frozen tolerance or adjacent distance bin
outputs.AS_composite: deprecated diagnostic: mean of available AS_yaw and AS_progress components; must not be used as the headline score
outputs.coverage: visual intervals and valid benchmark-v3 rows
